verdict.rationale: a-Shell is a Unix-like terminal for iOS, and terminals can plausibly ship built-in AI assistance, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents no AI-generated insights or suggestions. Bundled Python, pip and Vim linting are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not this capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
